acceptance_criteria: cargo build --features mdn succeeds; cargo test --features mdn passes all integration tests including RFC examples from draft §3.1 and §3.3; cargo build (no features) compiles cleanly
description: Implement JMAP MDN handling (draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17) as an `mdn` feature flag in jmap-mail-server and jmap-mail-types. Gives JMAP clients a structured API for sending email read receipts (MDN/send) and parsing received MDN blobs (MDN/parse), as defined in RFC 8098. Equivalent to what ManageSieve is for Sieve — a first-class JMAP interface over an existing email sub-protocol.
design: Only two methods: MDN/send and MDN/parse — no stored objects, no state, no /get /query /changes. Types behind mdn feature in jmap-mail-types. Handlers in src/mdn.rs behind mdn feature in jmap-mail-server. MdnBackend is a separate opt-in trait (same pattern as SieveBackend). MDN/send has a mandatory coupling with Email/set via onSuccessUpdateEmail to stamp the $mdnsent keyword — the server MUST reject MDN/send if onSuccessUpdateEmail does not set $mdnsent. MDN/parse returns parsed MDN fields from a raw RFC 5322 blob; forEmailId may be null if the originalMessageId cannot be correlated to a known message.
notes: Review converged after 3 rounds. Final review: JMAP-3l2l. 9 MDN integration tests. Residual open: JMAP-fwx5/z7we (P2 optimization), JMAP-had9/5vpz/77p9/bkqp (P3/opinion elegance). No P0/P1 remain.
title: jmap-mdn: MDN/send + MDN/parse in jmap-mail-server
